findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True and untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getMember("get").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getASubscript().getACall()
    |
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(SystemCommandExecution cmd |
      sink = cmd.getCommand()
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "untrusted input"
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with untrusted input from environment variables or command-line arguments

message.text:
Command injection from [untrusted input](1).
Command injection from [untrusted input](2).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using unsanitized user input in file paths can allow access to arbitrary files
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getMember("get").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getASubscript().getACall()
    |
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(FileSystemAccess fa |
      sink = fa.getAPathArgument()
    )
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "untrusted input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities where user-controlled input flows to file system operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe archive extraction (Zip Slip)
 * @description Extracting archives without validating paths can lead to arbitrary file writes
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-archive-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember("unpack_archive").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe archive extraction that could lead to path traversal (Zip Slip)."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction operations without proper path validation can lead to arbitrary file writes outside intended directories (Zip Slip vulnerability)

message.text: Potentially unsafe archive extraction that could lead to path traversal (Zip Slip).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, marshal, or shelve that could lead to arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded passwords or API keys in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assign assign, StrConst str
where
  (
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%pwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%", "%auth%"]) and
    assign.getValue() = str and
    str.getText().length() > 8 and
    not str.getText().matches(["%example%", "%test%", "%dummy%", "%placeholder%", "%your_%", "%<<%", "%>>%", "%***%", "%...%"])
  )
select assign, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + assign.getATarget().(Name).getId()
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded passwords, API keys, or other credentials in the source code
